WITH per_player AS (
    SELECT bp.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS avg_doubles
    FROM batting_postseason bp
    JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id
    GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats
),
indexed AS (
    SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles,
           avg_doubles / (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) FROM per_player) AS idx
    FROM per_player
),
gapped AS (
    SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx,
           idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS gap
    FROM indexed
)
SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, gap
FROM gapped
ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
WITH pp AS (
    SELECT b.player_id, p.bats, AVG(b."double") AS avg_doubles
    FROM batting_postseason b
    JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY b.player_id, p.bats
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(b."double") AS overall_avg
    FROM batting_postseason b
    JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
),
idx AS (
    SELECT pp.player_id, pp.bats, pp.avg_doubles,
           pp.avg_doubles / overall.overall_avg AS idx
    FROM pp, overall
)
SELECT player_id,
       bats,
       avg_doubles,
       idx,
       idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS gap
FROM idx
ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
WITH pa AS (
    SELECT b.player_id, p.bats, AVG(b."double") AS avg_doubles
    FROM batting_postseason b
    JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id
    GROUP BY b.player_id, p.bats
),
ov AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) AS overall_avg FROM pa
),
pidx AS (
    SELECT pa.player_id, pa.bats, pa.avg_doubles, pa.avg_doubles / ov.overall_avg AS idx
    FROM pa, ov
),
hand AS (
    SELECT pidx.bats, AVG(pidx.idx) AS hand_avg_idx
    FROM batting_postseason b
    JOIN pidx ON pidx.player_id = b.player_id
    GROUP BY pidx.bats
)
SELECT pidx.player_id,
       pidx.bats,
       pidx.avg_doubles,
       pidx.idx AS index_value,
       pidx.idx - hand.hand_avg_idx AS gap
FROM pidx
JOIN hand ON pidx.bats IS hand.bats
ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
WITH per_player AS (
    SELECT bp.player_id,
           p.bats AS bats,
           AVG(bp."double") AS avg_doubles
    FROM batting_postseason bp
    JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id
    GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats
),
indexed AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           bats,
           avg_doubles,
           avg_doubles / (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) FROM per_player) AS idx
    FROM per_player
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           bats,
           avg_doubles,
           idx,
           idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS gap
    FROM indexed
)
SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, gap
FROM grouped
ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
